title: mentha × verticillata var. weidenhofferi
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. weidenhofferi, commonly known as Weidenhoffer's mint or whorled mint, is a hybrid species of mint native to Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, which include digestive relief, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as nausea, indigestion, and mouth ulcers. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × verticillata var. weidenhofferi include its analgesic, carminative, and expectorant properties, which aid in relieving pain, reducing gas and bloating, and loosening mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
